ledger.what: remove cookie/consent chrome (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, generic cookie-banner ids/classes, any cookie/consent/gdpr-named element inside a fixed/sticky/high-z overlay)
ledger.why: overlay chrome injected by a CMP, not page content; re-added at deploy time

ledger.what: de-carousel slick/swiper/splide/glide: remove clone slides, force real slides visible+static, drop dots/arrows
ledger.why: hidden slides are absent from innerText and clones duplicate it — rotating carousels break byte determinism; the reskin renders all slides statically in DOM order

ledger.what: open every .nsw-accordion panel (unhide its content region, aria-expanded=true)
ledger.why: closed panel text is content; capture-only — the rendered accordion keeps the closed rest state

visibleTextNormalized: HomeOur communityParents and Citizens Association Parents and Citizens Association (P&C) The Parents and Citizens Association (P&C) is highly active and contributes substantially to the life of Fort Street High School. It provides a forum which enables parents to get involved in the organisation and direction of the school. The P&C initiates and supports programs to enhance student learning, manages the uniform shop and assists with running and fundraising for the Instrumental Music Program (IMP). Fort Street High School P&C Association is a group of parents and others who volunteer their time to help our school provide the best possible learning environment for all our children. Their aims are to: raise money for the school foster and improve communications between parents and the school enhance a sense of school community assist the school by establishing subcommittees which support the development of programs within the school (e.g. Instrumental Music Program, Uniform Shop, Sport). Parents are encouraged to be involved in whatever way suits their skills, interests and availability. The P&C usually meets in the school library at 7:30pm on the second Wednesday of each month during term. All parents are most welcome to attend and there are many opportunities to get involved. P&C FUNDRAISER Save up to 50% on dining, shopping, travel and things to do. An annual Entertainment Membership means getting more of what you need and love, while giving back to a cause you care about. Your purchase of an Entertainment Membership contributes to our Fort Street P&C fundraising, with 20% of every purchase going to the school. Help us achieve our fundraising goals by sharing the link with your friends and family. Thanks for your support! Purchase here: https://subscribe.entertainment.com.au/fundraiser/2d03327 (opens in new window) P&C Contribution Your payment of the P&C contribution will make a difference to your child’s education by providing educational resources necessary to meet the needs of gifted students in a selective school program, and by improving the school environment so that the grounds are a pleasant place for our students. P&C Membership Membership to the P&C is $1 per year, separate from school contributions. The membership form can be found here (opens in new window) . P&C Executive Committee President Ms Caroline Aow Vice President Ms Emma Pearce Mr Alex Ding Treasurer Mr Prabhu Sivabalan Secretary Ms Lucy Liang Executive Members Malcolm Groves Sivvy Xu Jens Olscher Elizabeth Kenyon Vivian Wang Tracey Chen P&C Representatives and Sub-committee Coordinators Foundation Representative Ms Caroline Aow IMP Representative Tania Koit and Paula Katalinic Finance Committee Representative Ms Caroline Aow Fundraising Committee Ms Elizabeth Kenyon Ms Emma Pearce Uniform shop Coordinator Ms Stella Liang Second Hand Uniform Coordinator Ms Emma Pearce Governance The P&C is a body corporate under the Parents & Citizens’ Association Incorporation Act 1976, the constitution can be viewed here. Fundraising One of the roles of the P&C is fundraising, which is contributed to the school, to provide better facilities than government funding covers. The funds that the P&C can make available to the school come from P&C memberships, uniform shop sales and the proceeds from events such as Fort Fest, IMP concerts and Senior Drama nights. In 2019 the P&C gave the school more than $200,000 to provide sporting facilities, classroom technology, faculty assets and numerous other items. Grants The P&C is also active in applying for local, state and federal government grants. Funds received from these grants enable the school to build better facilities for our students and run projects to improve educational outcomes. In 2020 the P&C won grants to refurbish the library foyer and establish the Kitchen Garden and composting program. If you have information about upcoming grants, experience with or an interest in applying for grants, please contact the P&C. (opens in new window) Community events Community Events run by the P&C aim to build community awareness within the school, give parents, students and other supporters an opportunity to meet informally and to contribute to the school and to raise funds. Meetings The P&C holds meetings usually at 7:30pm in the school library on the second Wednesday of each month during school terms. All meetings are hybrid and so may also be joined online via the link sent out via email. These meetings provide an opportunity to learn more about what is happening in the school, how it operates, to ask questions and to meet other parents. The Principal usually gives an informative report on the recent happenings within the school. The school emails details of upcoming meetings directly to parents and carers prior to the date. This email will include a copy of the upcoming agenda. Minutes from previous meetings are available below. All memberships are renewed yearly, before or at the annual general meeting. Please see the link to the membership form below for more details. If you wish to become a member, please fill out the linked membership form and email to the P&C via the address below or submit to the school office. Note that the fee for joining the P&C is $1, which can be paid to the P&C bank account via direct deposit (please ensure that you supply your name with the deposit). The P&C bank account details are: Fort Street High School P&C Association BSB: 032-267 Account: 247674 Contact: The P&C can be contacted on info@fortstreetpandc.org (opens in new window) Volunteer at our school Helping out at school is a great way to get involved in your school community.
